d:
Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in
the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom.
When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath
on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and
has a soak right there in view of everyone!
